name: Short waves with the largest time step
setup: Short waves at the edge of training (kh = kv = 6) with the largest time step dT = 0.1, 20× the DNS time step.
expect: A big time step is where the speed gain comes from. With dT = 0.1 the CFL number is about 1.2, slightly above the limit the MCL positivity proof needs (eq. 21).
observed: Still fine: h error about 0.4% for both reduced models, with no blow-up despite the slightly too large step.
